footer_unsubscribe_notification: Turn off emails like this one
common_button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:

match.minutesPlural=one: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minute.
match.minutesPlural=*: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.

match.hoursPlural=one: The link works once and expires in {hours} hour.
match.hoursPlural=*: The link works once and expires in {hours} hours.

common_automated_note: Automated checks find only part of all accessibility issues. Rampsmith lists what it checked and what still needs a person to review.
common_automated_source: Deque, the maker of axe-core, reports that axe-core finds on average 57% of WCAG issues automatically.
common_reason_store: You received this email because notifications for {store} are sent to this address.
common_reason_store_contact: You received this email because this address is the contact for {store} in Rampsmith.

match.minutesPlural=one: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minute.
match.minutesPlural=*: The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.

sign_in_link_intro: Use this link to sign in to the Rampsmith dashboard.
sign_in_link_do_not_forward: Do not forward this email. Anyone with the link can sign in as you until it expires.
sign_in_link_not_you: If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this email. The link stops working on its own, and your account stays as it is.
sign_in_link_reason: You received this email because someone asked to sign in to Rampsmith with this address.
email_verification_subject: Confirm your email address for Rampsmith
email_verification_preheader: Confirm this address to finish setting up your account.
email_verification_intro: Confirm that this address is yours to finish setting up your Rampsmith account.
email_verification_not_you: If you did not create a Rampsmith account, ignore this email. The address stays unconfirmed.
email_verification_reason: You received this email because this address was used to create a Rampsmith account.
delivery_test_intro: This is a test email from Rampsmith. If you can read it, email delivery works.
delivery_test_reason: You received this email because a Rampsmith operator sent a delivery test to this address.
scanner_confirm_subject: Confirm where to send your accessibility report
scanner_confirm_preheader: Confirm this address to receive the full report.
scanner_confirm_intro: Someone asked Rampsmith's free scanner to send a full accessibility report to this address.
scanner_confirm_nothing_else: Rampsmith sends nothing to this address until you confirm it.
scanner_confirm_not_you: If you did not ask for this report, ignore this email. Rampsmith will not write to this address again.
scanner_confirm_reason: You received this email because this address was entered in Rampsmith's free accessibility scanner.
scanner_report_preheader: Passes {passed} of {total} automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks.

match.pagesPlural=one: Rampsmith's free scanner checked 1 page of {host} on {date}, at one screen size.
match.pagesPlural=*: Rampsmith's free scanner checked {pages} pages of {host} on {date}, at one screen size.

scanner_report_learn_more: Rampsmith can fix many of these issues at the source, in a Shopify store's own data and theme code: {link}.
scanner_report_reason: You received this email because you asked Rampsmith's free scanner to send this report here and confirmed this address.
welcome_preheader: Your first scan of {store} is running. Here is what happens next.
welcome_intro: Rampsmith is now installed on {store}. It finds WCAG 2.2 AA failures in your store and fixes them at the source, in your own store data and theme code, with a dated record of every change.
welcome_next_scan: Your first scan is running. It checks your main page types and their interactive states, such as menus and the cart drawer.
welcome_next_results: When it finishes, Rampsmith emails you the results, ranked by their effect on shoppers.
welcome_next_approval: Fixes that need no code, such as image descriptions, wait for your approval. Nothing changes in your store until you approve it.
first_scan_subject: The first scan of {store} is finished
first_scan_preheader: {store} passes {passed} of {total} automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks.

match.pagesPlural=one: Rampsmith finished its first scan of {store} on {date}. It checked 1 page.
match.pagesPlural=*: Rampsmith finished its first scan of {store} on {date}. It checked {pages} pages.

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: No fixes are waiting for your approval yet.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=one: 1 fix is ready for your approval.
match.countExact=*, countPlural=*: {count} fixes are ready for your approval.

weekly_preheader: {store} passes {passed} of {total} automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks.
weekly_intro: Here is how {store} did in the week to {date}.
weekly_open_heading: Open issues by impact on shoppers
regression_preheader: Rampsmith found new failures after a recent change.

match.countPlural=one: Rampsmith's scan of {store} on {date} found 1 issue that was not there before.
match.countPlural=*: Rampsmith's scan of {store} on {date} found {count} issues that were not there before.

regression_cause_theme: They appeared after the theme “{theme}” was published.
regression_cause_commit: They appeared after commit {commit} was merged.
regression_cause_product: They appeared after product data changed.
regression_cause_unknown: Rampsmith could not tell which change caused them.
barrier_subject: A shopper reported an accessibility barrier on {store}
barrier_intro: A shopper used the accessibility form on {store} on {date} to report a barrier.
barrier_privacy: To keep the shopper's details private, the report is not included in this email. Read it in Rampsmith.
fix_approved_preheader: Here is what Rampsmith does next.
fix_approved_next_data: Store data fixes are written through Shopify's Admin API. Rampsmith then re-scans the affected pages to verify them.
fix_approved_next_pull_request: Code fixes go to your developer as a pull request. Rampsmith verifies them after it is merged.
fix_approved_next_theme_package: Code fixes are built into a patched copy of your theme for you to preview and publish.
fix_approved_log: The remediation log records who approved each fix, and when.
fix_verified_preheader: The results of Rampsmith's verification scan.
fix_verified_intro: Rampsmith re-scanned the affected pages of {store} on {date}.

match.countPlural=one: 1 fix now passes its automated check
match.countPlural=*: {count} fixes now pass their automated checks

match.countPlural=one: 1 fix still fails its automated check
match.countPlural=*: {count} fixes still fail their automated checks

fix_verified_failed_next: Open each one in Rampsmith to see the evidence and the next step.
plan_changed_intro: The Rampsmith plan for {store} changed from {previous} to {plan} on {date}.
plan_changed_billing: Shopify bills the plan and lists it on your Shopify invoice.
usage_preheader: What this means for your store, and what you can do.
usage_drafts_approaching_intro: {store} has used {used} of the {limit} alt-text drafts in its plan.
usage_drafts_reached_intro: {store} has used all {limit} alt-text drafts in its plan.
usage_drafts_paused_lifetime: Rampsmith drafts no more alt text unless the plan changes.
usage_drafts_paused_until: Rampsmith drafts no more alt text until {date}, when the allowance renews.
usage_unaffected: Scans, findings and the fixes you already approved keep working.
agency_invitation_subject: You are invited to join an agency on Rampsmith
agency_invitation_preheader: Accept the invitation to work on the agency's stores in Rampsmith.
agency_invitation_title: You are invited to an agency
agency_invitation_intro_admin: You are invited to join the agency “{organization}” on Rampsmith as an admin.
agency_invitation_intro_member: You are invited to join the agency “{organization}” on Rampsmith as a member.
agency_invitation_intro_viewer: You are invited to join the agency “{organization}” on Rampsmith as a viewer.
role_admin_can: Admins approve and undo fixes, connect GitHub and manage members.
role_member_can: Members run scans and propose and edit fixes.
role_viewer_can: Viewers can read findings, fixes and reports.
agency_invitation_not_expected: If you do not know this agency, ignore this email. Nobody is added unless you accept.
agency_invitation_reason: You received this email because someone at the agency “{organization}” invited this address to Rampsmith.
store_link_code_subject: A store-link code for your agency
store_link_code_preheader: Enter the code in your Rampsmith dashboard to link the store.
store_link_code_title: Link a store to your agency
store_link_code_intro: The owner of the store “{store}” shared a one-time code so that your agency can work on the store in Rampsmith.
store_link_code_steps: Sign in to your Rampsmith dashboard, choose Link a store, and enter the code.
store_link_code_expiry: The code works once and expires on {date}.
store_link_code_scope: Linking gives your agency access to this one store only. The store owner can remove that access at any time.
store_link_code_not_expected: If you did not expect this code, ignore this email. Nothing happens unless someone enters it.
store_link_code_reason: You received this email because the owner of the store “{store}” asked Rampsmith to send this code to this address.
store_linked_subject: An agency can now work on {store} in Rampsmith
store_linked_preheader: Review or remove the agency's access in Rampsmith.
store_linked_intro: The agency “{organization}” linked {store} to its Rampsmith dashboard on {date}, using a code you shared.
store_linked_access: People at “{organization}” can now see this store's findings and work on its fixes, within the roles their agency gives them.
store_linked_not_expected: If you did not expect this, remove the agency's access in Rampsmith.
data_deletion_store_intro: Rampsmith deleted the data it held for {store} on {date}: store content, theme snapshots, scan evidence, findings, fixes and the remediation log.
data_deletion_store_last: This is the last email Rampsmith sends about {store}.
data_deletion_account_intro: Rampsmith deleted your dashboard account on {date}: your email address, passkeys, sessions and memberships.
data_deletion_account_last: This is the last email Rampsmith sends to this address.
data_deletion_account_reason: You received this email because this address belonged to a Rampsmith account that was just deleted.
data_deletion_billing_kept: Rampsmith keeps billing records only for as long as tax law requires.
uninstall_intro: Rampsmith was uninstalled from {store}. It will delete the data it holds for the store on {date}.
uninstall_export: Before then, you can download the remediation record: every fix, its finding, its WCAG criterion, who approved it and when, and its verification result.
uninstall_expiry: The download link stops working when the data is deleted.
incident_preheader: What happened, what data is involved, and what Rampsmith is doing.
incident_intro_account: On {date}, Rampsmith confirmed a security incident that affects your account.
incident_intro_store: On {date}, Rampsmith confirmed a security incident that affects {store}.
incident_contact: Rampsmith will email you again if anything changes. If you have questions, write to {support}.
incident_reason_account: You received this email because this address belongs to a Rampsmith account affected by the incident.
subprocessor_preheader: The companies that process data on Rampsmith's behalf are changing.
subprocessor_intro: From {date}, Rampsmith will change the companies that process data on its behalf:
subprocessor_objection: To object to a change, write to {support} by {date}.
subprocessor_reason: You received this email because Rampsmith tells customers about subprocessor changes at least 30 days ahead.
